WITH scored_l12 AS (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.is_stable,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_c11.value AS "C11",
        cp_c12.value AS "C12",
        cp_c44.value AS "C44",
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 999.0), 0.0))
        END AS stability_score,
        1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
             AND cp_c44.value > 0
             AND (cp_c11.value + 2.0 * cp_c12.value) > 0
            THEN ((cp_c11.value - cp_c12.value) + 3.0 * cp_c44.value)
                 / NULLIF(cp_c11.value + ABS(cp_c12.value) + 3.0 * ABS(cp_c44.value), 0.0)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
    LEFT JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
    LEFT JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
)
SELECT
    formula,
    is_stable,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_diff,
    "C11",
    "C12",
    "C44",
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_match_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM scored_l12
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;
